review_evidence: The README explicitly describes the project as a Lean 4 formalisation of the mathematical foundations of physics aimed toward Hilbert's sixth problem.

The stated formal scope includes the GNS construction, causal/Lorentzian geometry, Haag-Kastler axioms, von Neumann algebras, purity/irreducibility/extremality, KMS states, and Killing-flow automorphisms.

The 71 formal-source files contain hundreds of theorems; representative results in Operators/Conjugation.lean include image_centralizer, exp_lieConj, lieConj_add, IsFactor.conj, and related operator-algebra statements.
